chapter_title_en: The Lord of the Xia’s Intervention
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 497: Ji Ning is saved by the Lord of the Xia from a furious Pure Yang True Immortal.
chapter_meta_description: A Pure Yang True Immortal hellbent on revenge traps Ji Ning, forcing the Lord of the Xia to personally intervene and grant the young Sword Immortal a powerful new life-saving talisman.
og_title: The Lord of the Xia Just Became Ji Ning’s Best Ally
og_description: When a True Immortal master of Qiankun blocks all escape, only an ancient imperial lord can tear through reality to save the day.
twitter_title: The Xia Emperor just handed Ji Ning a get-out-of-jail-free card
twitter_description: A Pure Yang True Immortal’s spatial lockdown meets its match as the Lord of the Xia arrives with a legendary spirit-treasure.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, a powerful Pure Yang True Immortal descendant of the ancient Xiamang imperial clan, wielding multiple innate spirit-treasures.
A Pure Yang True Immortal who has fully mastered the Grand Dao of Qiankun, driven by rage over the death of a woman called 'Zicao' (Purple Grass).
The Grand Dao governing space and time as a unified force; mastering it grants absolute authority over local spatial topology, blocking all forms of teleportation.
An innate spirit-treasure belonging to the Lord of the Xia, capable of forcibly tearing through spatial seals to deliver its owner to a target location.
A Ki Refining cultivator who has reached the pinnacle of the True Immortal stage, purifying their foundation to a state of pure Yang energy.
One of the seven Empyrean Gods residing in Ji Ning's aquatic palace, a powerful ally bound by a one-time promise to help him.
The primary antagonist faction in the tribulation, a shadowy organization waging a secret war against the powers of the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn’t Ji Ning use Greater Teleportation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Fu Hua True Immortal had mastered the Grand Dao of Qiankun, giving him absolute control over the spatial topology of the area. This made any long-range teleportation within his domain impossible.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Lord of the Xia come so late?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He had to use his innate spirit-treasure, the ‘One Thought, One Heart Lamp,’ to forcibly tear through Fu Hua’s spatial seal. This method is slower than standard teleportation, which is why he arrived at the last moment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did the seven Empyrean Gods’ promise get used up?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. The Lord of the Xia arrived before Ji Ning had to call on them, so the one-time promise remains intact for a future emergency.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the talisman the Lord of the Xia gave Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a personal life-saving talisman that, when crushed, will summon the Lord of the Xia instantly. He claims he can save Ji Ning from any enemy below the level of a True God or Daofather.
